`abstract class GlyphTextRenderer<F extends IFontFace>`<br/>
**Implements:** [`ITextRenderer`](/reference/text/itextrenderer/)<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`BitmapTextRenderer`](/reference/text/bitmaptextrenderer/), [`MsdfTextRenderer`](/reference/text/msdftextrenderer/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.font.impl.glyph` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [GlyphTextRenderer.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/font/impl/glyph/GlyphTextRenderer.java)

Base class of the text renderers of glyph fonts, which lays out, kerns, styles and shadows the text and leaves the drawing of each glyph to you.

## Description

[`MsdfTextRenderer`](/reference/text/msdftextrenderer/) and [`BitmapTextRenderer`](/reference/text/bitmaptextrenderer/) extend it.
Extend it for a [`GlyphFont`](/reference/text/glyphfont/) of your own: pass the core shader that draws your glyphs to the constructor and implement `drawGlyph`.
On each draw, the renderer lays out the string with [`TextMarkup`](/reference/text/textmarkup/), runs the text effects, draws the shadow then the glyphs between `begin()` and `end()`, inside a pushed render state.
The shader is created on the first draw; when the backend cannot compile it, the text is skipped with one dev-mode warning and its bounds are still returned.

<a id="GlyphTextRenderer-method-begin"></a>

### begin

`void begin()` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

JOID calls it before the glyphs of a pass are drawn: it binds the shader, resets the color and reads the pixel grid.
An override binds its texture or uniforms and calls `super.begin()` first.

<a id="GlyphTextRenderer-method-end"></a>

### end

`void end()` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

JOID calls it after the glyphs of a pass, even when a glyph throws: it unbinds the shader.
An override calls `super.end()`.

<a id="GlyphTextRenderer-method-drawGlyph"></a>

### drawGlyph

`void drawGlyph(TextGlyph<F> glyph)` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">abstract</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

JOID calls it for each glyph of a pass, between `begin()` and `end()`.
Draw the glyph at its x plus offset, on its baseline, at its size, in its color through `bindColor`, and slant it when [`TextGlyph.isSlanted`](/reference/text/textglyph/#TextGlyph-method-isSlanted) is `true`.

<a id="GlyphTextRenderer-method-isGridAligned"></a>

### isGridAligned

`boolean isGridAligned()` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

If `true`, the origin, the baseline and the offsets of the glyphs snap to whole screen pixels, for pixel fonts; `false` by default.

<a id="GlyphTextRenderer-method-bindColor"></a>

### bindColor

`void bindColor(Color color)` <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

Sends `color` to the shader, a gradient spread over the run included; an unchanged color instance sends nothing.
